# BOLOBAN SHOP — llms.txt

> Bangladesh-focused multi-vendor ecommerce marketplace. pnpm monorepo, React 19 + Express 5 + MySQL 8, TypeScript 5.9, Node 22+ (tested on 22.14 and 24). Custom scrypt-based auth, server-side sessions in an httpOnly cookie.

## What this project is

A complete ecommerce marketplace that lets shoppers browse categories and
deals, search and sort products, view product details and reviews, save
items to a persistent cart, and check out with cash-on-delivery, bKash, or
Nagad. The marketplace UI is a React SPA; the API is an Express 5 server
backed by MySQL through Drizzle ORM.

## Stack

- **Frontend** — React 19, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS 4, TanStack Query, wouter
- **Backend** — Express 5, Node.js 24, TypeScript 5.9, esbuild bundle
- **Database** — MySQL 8, Drizzle ORM (decimal prices, varchar ids, timestamp_ms)
- **Validation** — Zod (with `zod/v4` for the schema package)
- **Auth** — Clerk (production); bypass flag `CLERK_DEV_BYPASS=true` for local dev
- **Test stack** — Vitest, better-sqlite3 (in-process), supertest, @testing-library/react, jsdom

## Workspace layout (high level)

- `artifacts/bazarhub/` — React marketplace app (`@workspace/bazarhub`)
  - Pages: `home`, `products`, `fresh-market`, `product-detail`, `cart`, `orders`, `account`, `surface`
  - Libs: `cart` (Context + localStorage persistence), `clerk-dev-shim` (test/dev shim)
- `artifacts/api-server/` — Express API (`@workspace/api-server`)
  - Routes: `/api/healthz`, `/api/categories`, `/api/products`, `/api/products/:id`, `/api/products/:id/reviews`, `/api/deals`, `/api/orders`
- `lib/db/` — Drizzle schema + connection (`@workspace/db`)
- `lib/api-zod/` — Zod schemas (`@workspace/api-zod`)
- `lib/api-client-react/` — Generated React Query hooks (`@workspace/api-client-react`)
- `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` — OpenAPI source of truth

## API surface (dialect-agnostic, runs on the MySQL backend)

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET  | /api/healthz | Health check → `{ status: "ok" }` |
| GET  | /api/categories | List categories |
| GET  | /api/products | List products. Query: `q`, `category`, `sort` (popular\|price_asc\|price_desc\|rating), `limit` (≤50) |
| GET  | /api/products/:id | Get a product |
| GET  | /api/products/:id/reviews | List reviews for a product |
| GET  | /api/deals | Top 6 deals by discount |
| POST | /api/orders | Place an order. Body: `{ items: [{productId, quantity}], customerName, phone, address, paymentMethod: "cod"\|"bkash"\|"nagad" }`. When authenticated, the order's `user_id` is set to the signed-in user. |
| GET  | /api/orders | List recent orders |
| POST | /api/auth/signup | Create an account. Body: `{ email, password (≥8), name, phone?, role? }` |
| POST | /api/auth/signin | Sign in. Body: `{ email, password }`. Sets the `boloban_session` cookie. |
| POST | /api/auth/signout | Sign out. Clears the session cookie. |
| GET  | /api/auth/me | Returns the current user, or 401. |
| POST | /api/dev/seed-users | Idempotent: insert the three demo users when `?key=$DEV_SEED_KEY` is correct. |

## Demo users (seed via POST /api/dev/seed-users)

- `shopper@boloban.local` / `Shopper123!` — role: shopper
- `seller@boloban.local` / `Seller123!` — role: seller
- `admin@boloban.local`  / `Admin123!`  — role: admin

## Cart semantics

- Persisted to `localStorage["bazarhub-cart"]`. Malformed JSON falls back
  to an empty cart.
- `addItem` clamps quantity to `product.stock`. If `stock === 0` exactly 1
  is added (defensive default).
- `updateQuantity(0)` removes the item.

## Test suite

67 tests across 5 files, ~3 s. `pnpm test`. CI on GitHub Actions:
[`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml).

The api-server tests mock `@workspace/db` with an in-memory SQLite
mirror of the production MySQL schema — no external services needed.

## Production deploy

[deploy.sh](deploy.sh) builds both apps and uploads them via FTP to
`ftp.bengaliislamicinstitute.com`. See
[deployment_instructions.txt](deployment_instructions.txt) for the
target server config. The api-server runs under Node.js v22+ (LTS).

## Conventions

- All packages use ESM (`"type": "module"`).
- Workspace aliases: `@workspace/db`, `@workspace/api-zod`, `@workspace/api-client-react`.
- In the bazarhub frontend, the `@/*` alias maps to `artifacts/bazarhub/src/*`.
- All routes use only portable drizzle operators (`eq`, `or`, `and`, `like`, `asc`, `desc`).
- The Drizzle schema is defined twice: MySQL for production, SQLite for tests.
